title: Sketch of the Analytical Engine invented by Charles Babbage, Esq., with Notes by the Translator
version: Scientific Memoirs, vol. III, article XXIX, pp. 666–731, and table. Lovelace’s annotated English translation of Menabrea’s 1842 memoir.
lineage: Original printed pages scanned by Internet Archive (scientificmemoir03memo), in a standalone PDF of the article. Menabrea had learned about the design from Babbage. Lovelace’s own signed notes add technical detail to the translation.

passages.quote: The solution of this problem has been taken from Jacquard’s apparatus
passages.note: Describes the holes in successive loom cards mechanically selecting levers, and the Engine design’s separate operation and variable cards.

Describes backing the cards in groups as a way to repeat operations and introduces the separate proposal to apply it to weaving. The detailed explanation of a prism in this note refers to the proposed loom use.
In the Engine design, the prism presents successive perforated cards to the levers and can rotate backward to put a set of cards back in its former position.
